symptom: A Starlark rule using widgets(), xpath_expressions(), activities_for(), permissions(), permissions_for() or page.widget_count reports nothing under `mxcli lint` (widgets() = 0 vs 46 with REQUIRES = ["full"]); built-in MPR005 / MPR006 / MPR012 (ctx.Widgets()) were silent the same way — an empty container went unreported
cause: Those read tables/columns only REFRESH CATALOG FULL writes, but only refs_to / refs_from were in fullBuiltins, and no Go rule implemented RequiredCatalogMode, so lint built the fast catalog and the queries answered [] with no warning (SatisfiesCatalogMode only checks refs)
insight: Do not hand-maintain the full-only list: starlark_catalog_mode_guard_test.go builds PedApp fast and full, runs every builtin on both and requires anything that differs (row count or any struct field) to be auto-detected; rules/catalog_mode_guard_test.go scans Go rules for full-only LintContext members. A new builtin must be classified there or the test fails
